# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Filtered image and glyph correctness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.2 improves filtered-image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering. These pending servicing fixes retain the existing managed API and native ABI.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep filtered images within their texture subsets** — Corrects antialiased and multisampled sampling under minification or strong skew so unrelated backing-texture pixels do not bleed into filtered images. Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, including signed-zero and matrix-metadata differences. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Handle changing mask-filtered glyphs safely** — Uses the reloaded glyph's path and validates mask formats before copying. Correct full-plane strides and clearing for clipped embossed glyphs prevent stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted mask planes. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
